analysis_role: Specific falsification of supported H1. Test whether the fixed (+BIO15,-BIO1) branchwise transition-regime concordance persists after removing linear latitude/longitude structure from both environmental axes.

fixed_hypothesis.interpretation: U->D transition probability should align with higher geography-residual BIO15 and lower geography-residual BIO1.

geography_adjustment.model_each_axis: environmental centroid ~ 1 + latitude centroid + longitude centroid
geography_adjustment.residualization: ordinary least squares within each panel, followed by z-scoring of residuals
geography_adjustment.reason: Remove the simplest linear geographic gradient before phylogenetic branchwise reconstruction; this is not spatially exhaustive deconfounding.

method.discrete_estimator: identical symmetric CTMC edge-joint posterior estimator from chapter2_orientation_transition_regime_hypothesis_v1
method.continuous_estimator: Brownian squared-change reconstruction of geography-residual z(BIO15) and z(BIO1)
method.primary_statistic: (S_residBIO15 - S_residBIO1)/sqrt(2), median across six accepted topologies
method.null: all count-preserving state maps; CTMC refit for every map; geography-residual environmental values fixed
method.exact_rank: one-sided fraction with median composite >= observed, observed map included

decision_rule.supported: strict_n10 observed composite positive on all six topologies and exact fraction <=0.05
decision_rule.directional_not_exceptional: strict_n10 positive on all six topologies but exact fraction >0.05
decision_rule.direction_destabilized: at least one strict_n10 topology composite <=0
decision_rule.n5_role: secondary sensitivity only; cannot rescue strict_n10 failure

claim_ceiling: Passing this test rules out only a simple linear latitude/longitude explanation, not all spatial or regional confounding.
Present-day residual niche centroids are not historical transition-time environments.
No result identifies temperature, precipitation seasonality, rain/wetting, UV, pollination, selection, adaptation, or fitness causation.
No environmental variable or direction may be changed after inspection.
